methodology: 1M/3M returns are trailing 21/63 trading-day price changes. Vol (per name) = annualised stdev of that name's own trailing 21-day daily returns. Basket vol = same calculation pooled across the equity subset. Breadth = % of equity subset trading above its own 50-day moving average. Drawdown = max peak-to-trough over trailing 90 sessions per name. Descriptive only; not a signal or recommendation.
